create_protobuf_model: create a ProtobufModel instance wrapping caffe2 predict and init nets for inference
run_protobuf_model_forward: run forward pass on ProtobufModel with a tuple of torch tensors as inputs
create_protobuf_detection_model: create a ProtobufDetectionModel from caffe2 nets to run detection inference like a PyTorch module
run_detection_model_forward: run forward pass on ProtobufDetectionModel with batched inputs to get detection results
infer_output_devices: infer output device types for each external output blob based on input tensor devices
